info.title: WESAL API
info.description: WESAL | وِصال – Connected B2B marketplace for retail sales & distribution

get.description: Runtime translation overrides edited by admins; merged over the frontend bundles.
Aggregate, non-sensitive marketplace numbers for the landing page.

post.description: CSV import (UTF-8, header row). Creates/updates offers; rows with errors are reported, not applied.

get.description: Product-level search with offer summary (count, best price) for comparison.
Offers the representative is currently authorized to sell (effective authorizations only).

post.description: Approve a representative's request (or a draft) by issuing terms for acceptance.
Changing the recorded acquisition source requires a dedicated permission and a documented reason.

get.description:
Registered stores that opted into discovery, within the rep's work areas (or near a given point).
Location is used only for this request and not stored.
Actionable opportunities: lapsed customers, due follow-ups, open opportunities, undiscovered stores.

put.description: Edit a draft, or adjust a representative's order before approving it (creates a new version).

post.description: Accept the order at the prices/quantities the retailer already approved.

Submit a price offer (quotation). The order's lines take the offered values and the
retailer must approve this exact version.
Change quantities/prices after approval (e.g. stock shortage) → retailer must re-approve.

Supplier marks as delivered (optionally with proof). The store then confirms receipt;
without a response the order auto-completes after the configured number of days.
Attach the supplier's own tax invoice (issued by the supplier's e-invoicing solution).
Goods physically received back: update returned quantities, order status, and commission (once).
Record an off-platform payout for approved commissions of ONE representative.
